oam_selector_26_alias.interpretation: Valid extended OAM layout reached through the first record's second word; ID 71 selector 26 is not out of range for this OAM lookup.

callback_index_1_direct_dispatch_search.interpretation: No exact immediate-parameter callsite found; this does not rule out split or computed callback parameters.

adjacent_slot_state_evidence.neighbor_selection: build candidates adjacent to the $6408 slot from paired $64B7/$648F fields; choose one candidate by $65A8:$65A7 when multiple qualify
adjacent_slot_state_evidence.interpretation: $6409 may mirror $6408 on the $670F==0 path, be selected from slots adjacent to $6408, or be explicitly invalidated; the active state at either bank-12 dispatch is not established.

matching_oam_layout_lookup.relationship: same $6408 slot and $6467 graphic ID as bank-12 CHR callback index 0

bank12_selector_26_stream.interpretation: Bank 18 selects the OAM layout at $802E using $6408 and $6467, then calls bank-12 callback index 0 at $8285/$8529, which uses the same $6408 slot and $6467 graphic ID to select CHR. This is a direct static pairing for selector 26. Bank 18 also has another OAM path that reads $6409; bank 2 can copy $6408 into $6409, select a slot adjacent to $6408 into $6409, or invalidate it, so that secondary path is state-dependent. Runtime CHR residency is not emulator-confirmed.

ppu_callback_selector_26.status: not included in the 25 canonical PPU streams; requires callback-gate/runtime tracing before treating as a valid upload

graphic_selector_audit.interpretation: The 25-entry primary tables have adjacent data/code aliases. Selector 26 resolves to a structurally valid 56-entry OAM layout, while its NMI PPU-stream path remains unresolved.

movement_allowance.selection: LDX $6408 selects the active unit slot; when $05CC == 0, LDA $66BF,X reads that unit's movement allowance
movement_allowance.cost_accounting: subtracts $05E6 from the allowance, stores the remainder back to $05E6, and callers reject negative remainder; $05CC != 0 uses $670F instead
movement_allowance.distance_formula: Manhattan distance: absolute horizontal delta plus absolute vertical delta, with screen/map offsets normalized and each axis converted to 16-pixel tiles
movement_allowance.unit: movement points compared against Manhattan tile distance
movement_allowance.caveat: passability and occupancy constraints are not fully decoded; no terrain-weighted cost appears in this helper

interpretation: Counted groups and referenced IDs are byte-verified. IDs 0-71 index fixed-stride data before the $8F24 code entrypoint. ID 72 is preserved as a special overlapping index and must not be decoded as a 13-byte unit definition. The supplied parameter-chart transcription independently matches movement allowances for visible IDs 0-55 and corroborates bytes 0-3 and 6 as HP, attack, and defense fields in its displayed rows; bytes 4-5 mostly align with required experience but differ at type IDs 14 and 17; byte 8 matches listed skill IDs where shown; byte 9 feeds the graphic selector array. Byte 7 is also consumed by the bank-2 movement-cost routine at $8B8A. Bytes 10-12 remain unresolved.
